header: This is the permanent store of executive briefings (table public.eds_briefing, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/20_eds_briefing.sql). Why it exists: a model gives a different briefing at every call, and a server's own memory is no help on Vercel (every instance and every cold start has its own, empty one). So I write the first GOOD briefing of a question to the database, and every later ask of the same question, on any server, reads that one. It stays valid until the archive of circulars changes (`fingerprint()`), or the prompt / rules of the engine change (the key carries a signature of both). Two servers generating the same question at the same moment cannot both win: the insert keeps the FIRST row (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) and both servers show the row that stands. My rule: nothing here may break an answer. Any database trouble is logged once and the engine carries on without the store.

doc: A short text that changes whenever a circular is added, removed, renamed or re-read.
